digest.component_or_area: Jira bridge adapters (Cloud, Data Center, family seam)
propositions: Jira Cloud and Data Center deployments require a unified adapter family to prevent duplication and private-import violations across separate adapter packages

Cloud (REST v3 + ADF, accountId identity, ACLI auth) and DC (REST v2 + wiki markup, name identity, PAT auth) must share field maps, sanitizers, and link vocabularies through a single definition in a jira_family sub-layer, with variation points parameterized as contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel)

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) cannot relocate without breaking the dynamic loader, but must be dependency-inverted to import from jira_family rather than duplicating shared logic

DC authentication must require https with strict TLS verification (certificate validation never disabled), configurable ca_bundle for internal CAs, and PAT from environment only—never from config file

The bridge must refuse DC's non-https base_url unless allow_insecure=true is explicitly set and logged as a security warning, to prevent credentials crossing the wire in cleartext on self-hosted deployments

Bidirectional reconciliation against a real DC instance must demonstrate that issues created in DC appear in the local store after an inbound pass and local edits appear in DC after an outbound pass, with zero unhandled exceptions
